mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_pay_record WHERE out_trade_no = #{outTradeNo} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE t_pay_record SET business_status = #{processingStatus}, business_error = NULL, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND del_flag = 0 AND (business_status IS NULL OR business_status IN (#{pendingStatus}, #{failedStatus})) LIMIT 1
UPDATE t_pay_record SET business_status = #{successStatus}, business_error = NULL, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND del_flag = 0 LIMIT 1

UPDATE t_pay_record SET business_status = #{failedStatus}, business_retry_count = COALESCE(business_retry_count, 0) + 1, business_error = #{errorMessage}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND del_flag = 0 LIMIT 1

UPDATE t_pay_record SET business_status = #{failedStatus}, business_error = '业务处理超时，等待重新补偿', update_time = NOW() WHERE business_status = #{processingStatus} AND update_time < #{staleBefore} AND del_flag = 0
